answer: A cipher of per-task receipts records who did what, and the lantern of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. What survives to the lotus is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks.
